part: Upper bulkhead (gear box upper half) of the Carten T410R, new design
coordinate_system: Same as the lower bulkhead: origin at the centre of the 4 bottom holes of the lower part on its bottom face, x along the diff axis, +y toward the pinion and the centre shaft, +z up. The upper part sits on the parting face (z = axis_z of the lower part). Heights named h_... are measured from the parting face.
shared_parameters: cad/bulkhead/bulkhead_lower_parameters.json: parting face height, diff axis, bearing seats and lips, gear cavities, pinion seat, radii and edge chamfers of the outer shape, positions and sizes of the 4 screw bosses of the lower part.
design: Prismatic part: the footprint of the lower part, extruded to 4 flat levels along y (flange, gear block, shock tower wall, top brace face). All outer faces are flat. The edges have radii and edge chamfers as the lower part, the root of the shock tower wall a radius (wall_root_r); the only other curved faces are the bores and the cavities, which follow the lower part.

source_codes.caliper: Caliper measurement of the stock upper part by the owner of the car (measurement sheet of the upper part, number in the note)
source_codes.user: Information from the owner of the car
source_codes.brace: Geometry data of the top brace (cad/chassis/top_brace/top_brace_geometry.json)
source_codes.photo: Estimate from photos of the stock upper part (second set, rulers in the views), accuracy approx. +-1.5 mm. To be replaced by caliper values (measurement sheet of the upper part).
source_codes.design: Design choice of the new part, free

outer_end_y.note: Outer end of the upper part. The stock upper part ends approx. 4.2 mm beyond the outer screw holes, so that the sway bar holders (M3x6 from above onto the tabs of the lower part, manual step 23) have room.

corner_r.note: Corner radius of the footprint (top view).

cover_wall.note: Wall thickness in front of the ring gear cavity (radius 16.4 of the lower part). Sets the front face of the gear block: diff axis - 16.4 - 2.0 = -17.9.

gear_block_h.note: Top of the gear block above the parting face (tower_keepout_h minus wall_root_r). Cover over the ring gear cavity (16.4 at the diff axis): 1.4 directly behind the wall, 2.5 at the contact face; above the diff axis is the wall.

deck_h.note: U9: top brace contact face above the parting face (flat face from deck_end_y - 0.5 to the pinion end).

deck_end_y.note: End of the top brace above the bulkhead: 11.50 at the end with B01 to B04 (deck_screw_y - 3.35), 11.03 at the end with B07 to B15 (deck_screw_y - 3.82). The gear block ends 0.5 before the smaller value.

deck_screw_x.note: U7: spacing across 25.6 (28.6 - 3.0). Position of the 2 top brace screws in x (+-).

deck_screw_y.note: Position of the 2 top brace screws in y (distance from the bulkhead centre toward the middle of the car): (distance of the bulkhead centres on the chassis plate 265.83 - distance B01 to B14 of the top brace 236.13) / 2. The top brace and the chassis plate are confirmed by their test print. Before: 14.36 (pinion side screws 21.3 minus 6.94, B01 to B03 of the top brace). Open: U8.

deck_hole_depth.note: Drill depth. Screws M3x8 (manual step 25) through the 2 mm top brace: 6 mm thread engagement.

pinion_end_r.note: Half width and height of the block over the outer pinion bearing beyond the end of the footprint (same section as the block of the lower part below it).

ring_dome_x_outer.note: Outer end (|x|) of the ring gear cavity in the upper part: back face of the ring gear 9.4 (photo) + 1.0 clearance. With the cavity up to the bearing seat (11.35), the wall to the tapped hole of the top brace screw was 0.2 mm (check for thin walls). Wall now 1.15.

boss_recess_clearance.note: Diametral clearance of the 4 recesses on the underside for the bosses of the lower part (boss 4.86, recess 5.06).

boss_recess_extra_depth.note: Recess depth = boss height above the parting face (2.42) + 0.1.

screw_hole_d.note: Clearance hole of the 4 M3 screws to the lower part.

counterbore_d.note: Counterbore for the heads of the pinion side screws (button head 5.7) from the top brace face down to the head seat.

screw_len_outer.note: Button head screws M3x8 on the outer side. The heads sit on the flange.

screw_len_pinion.note: Button head screws M3x10 on the pinion side. The top brace has access holes above them (B03/B04 and B12/B13).

thread_engagement.note: Thread engagement of the 4 screws in the bosses of the lower part (1.8 x d). Sets the head seats: h = boss height 2.42 + screw length - 5.5, outer side 4.92 (= flange thickness), pinion side 6.92.

tower_face_y.note: Contact face of the shock tower (faces the outer side). Side views: 5.1 to 6.7 mm from the diff axis toward the outer side. Open: U5, U6.

tower_hole_x.note: U1: spacing across 19.1 (22.0 - 2.9). Position of the 4 shock tower holes in x (+-).

tower_hole_h_lower.note: U3: height of the centre of the 2 lower shock tower holes above the parting face.

tower_hole_d.note: Tap drill for M3, through the wall. Stock part: 2.9, through, 5.8 long (U4).

tower_plate_t.note: Thickness of the carbon shock towers (spec_cartent410r.yaml).

tower_screw_len.note: 4 button head screws M3x8 per shock tower (steps 19 and 20). Thread engagement in the wall: 5.0.

tower_keepout_h.note: In front of the contact face, the zone above this height is kept free for the shock tower: top of the gear block 17.8 plus the root radius of the wall 2.0. The shock tower is to be a new design. The stock shock tower plate reaches down to approx. 17.8 (lower holes 22.5 minus 4.7, estimate, U11 open) and does not fit.

wall_t.note: Thickness of the shock tower wall in y, full width of the part. Screw M3x8 through the 3 mm tower: 5.0 thread engagement, 1.0 left. Stock part: ears 5.8 thick (U4).

wall_root_r.note: Radius at the root of the shock tower wall on both sides (gear block to wall), around the vertical corners of the wall, for the strength of the wall (radius requested by the owner). The shock tower is to be a new design that fits the radius; the stock shock tower plate (lower edge estimated at 17.8) does not fit.

wall_top_h.note: U10: top of the shock tower wall above the parting face (top of the stock ears). Material above the thread of the upper holes: 1.4.

print_seat_allowance.note: Test print only: added to the bearing seat diameters.

print_tap_d.note: Test print only: diameter of the tapped holes for self-tapping screws.
